name: Mneme
description: <title>Abstract</title> The rapid expansion of Machine Learning (ML) applications, especially within its subfield of Deep Learning (DL), has created an increasing demand for efficient preprocessing of large tabular datasets that surpass the available memory capacity of single-node systems. This paper introduces a parallel framework, developed as a Python library, designed to efficiently preprocess large-scale tabular datasets for training Deep Neural Networks (DNNs).
